name: How much does it cost to install a custom water feature?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install a custom water feature?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of installing a custom water feature varies significantly based on its size, complexity, materials, and chosen components like pumps, filtration, and lighting. A small, pre-fabricated fountain might start in the low thousands, while a large, custom-designed pond or multi-tiered waterfall can range from tens of thousands to over a hundred thousand dollars. Factors such as site preparation, accessibility, and electrical work also influence the total investment. We provide detailed proposals after an initial consultation and site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom water feature costs vary widely by size, complexity, and materials, from a few thousand for small features to over a hundred thousand for large custom designs.
